steps.name: write the code
steps.instructions: Write the code for the request, in the files it needs and no more, following how this project already does things. Write no tests: the test author writes them next, for what you built. Say in a few lines what you changed and how it can be tested.

steps.name: write the tests
steps.instructions: The implementer just wrote the code for the request (the uncommitted changes). Write tests that prove it works: the main case, a wrong input and an edge case, in the project's own test style. They should pass now. If a test fails because the code is wrong, keep the test and say what is wrong; never weaken a test to make it pass.

steps.name: fix what fails
steps.instructions: The tests fail. Fix the code so they pass. Change a test only when it is wrong against the request, and say why in one line.

steps.name: commit the code and its tests
